2025-09-19

This is for DAVID 2016 (6.8 version)

Analysing paper PMID:37436901

Loading libraries

library("clusterProfiler")
library("kableExtra")
library("dplyr")
library("rio")
library("here")
library("gtsummary")
library("ggplot2")
library("rmarkdown")

Input gene list:

#genelist <- read.table("../input_lists/Repro_check/Low impact gene lists/params$37436901_endothelial_input.txt")

genelist <- read.table(params$gene_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#getwd() 
#setwd("..")

Genevec <- genelist[, 1]

Loading GO datsets

Convert gene lists to dataframe for clusterprofiler

Performing Enrichment analysis

for TERM2GENE, options are: gobp_terms, gocc_terms, gomf_terms, gocombined_terms

ora <- as.data.frame(enricher(gene = Genevec ,
                              minGSSize = 10,
                              maxGSSize = 50000, 
                              TERM2GENE =  gomouse, 
                              pAdjustMethod="fdr",  
                              pvalueCutoff = 1, 
                              qvalueCutoff = 1  ))

ora$geneID <- gsub("/", " ", ora$geneID) #to separate geneIds from /

dim(ora)
## [1] 3114   12
ora$ID <- NULL
rownames(ora) <- NULL #removing empty 1st column name

ora$S_No <- seq_len(nrow(ora))
ora <- ora[, c("S_No", names(ora)[-which(names(ora) == "S_No")])]

head(ora)
